deliberation: The successor can be expressed as a closed operating contract. A reviewer request is routine-invalid when the requested identity is jimsteeg and no valid GI-STEWARD-0002 recovery instance is bound. Premerge-required remains the active ruleset predicate. Postmerge-select returns the union of suites attached to direct and transitive changed classes, while unknown or drift returns full fanout. Readback terminates as observed pass, downstream hold, or recovery pending and never as approval or activation.
